DWP.5 states that it is not the mixed-characteristic conjecture, and R34.6 that the general conjecture is no assumption. Every import named exists: DWP.0/4/5/7, LPV.1, R01.2, LocalFieldsRamification Layer 4, P3, H5, L5, EDC.2 and EDC.3, SF.2 and SF.5.
